office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Rhonda Laumann is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge elected in 2018 and seeking a third term, currently assigned to civil cases, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: Currently handles civil cases; previously criminal, small claims, and protection orders [S1]
Trains pro tem judges and teaches for the National Institute of Trial Advocacy [S1]
